summary: Stdcall string hashing helper. Returns -1 for a null pointer, 0 for an empty string, and otherwise hashes four sampled characters (first, one-sixth, midpoint, last) run through a per-character transform helper sub_589A35, then reduces the result modulo 9, so the returned value is a 0..8 bucket index. Called by hash-table lookup and file-data processing paths.

local_names.v2: result when the string is empty (0)

operations.description: Only hash when the string is non-empty: if (v3 > 0).
Run the first character through the per-character transform helper: v4 = sub_589A35(*a1) (the a1[0] dereference recorded as field this+0x0).
Sample a character near the front of the string: v5 = sub_589A35(a1[v3 / 6]).
Partial sum: v6 = v4 + 10 * v5 + v5.
Sample the midpoint character: v7 = sub_589A35(a1[v3 / 2]).
Return (189 * v7 + v6 + 756 * v7 + 10097 * sub_589A35(a1[v3 - 1])) % 9, i.e. the weighted sum of the four transformed samples reduced modulo 9.
Return v2 (0) when the string is empty (v3 == 0).
